one_liner: Pinterest API v5 is a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0, free but gated by Pinterest's Trial approval and a Standard-access review; an official MCP server exists.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with app ID and secret. Access tokens last 30 days and refresh tokens are supported. Trial-tier test tokens are also mentioned in the evidence, but OAuth is the main path.
access_notes: There is no API fee. A business account must request Trial access, and Pinterest reviews each request (typically 1-3 business days). Trial pins are visible only to their creator and have low rate limits. Standard access needs a review that includes a video demo of the OAuth flow.
blocker_notes: New apps need Trial approval, then a Standard-access review (demo video) before real multi-user use. Trial content is sandboxed to its creator.

evidence.quote: Make sure your API requests on a user"s behalf include a current access token that identifies the user and defines your permissions, or scopes
Access tokens30 days. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and renew each time they're used
Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest. You will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed, letting you know whether it was approved or denied access.
If you are the only intended user of the Pinterest API, we will still require a video recording of the OAuth flow.
Pinterest does not publish API access fees for v5. No price card, no per-call meter, no subscription fee.
263 of Pinterest's 266 published operations are reachable.
